<environment_context>
cwd: <CWD>
git: no
entries: README.md, go.mod, internal/
GOMODCACHE/GOCACHE are already redirected to a writable path under $HOME for you, so `go build`/`go test` need no cache setup of your own.
Toolchains are installed read-only under /usr - you cannot upgrade one in place; per-project dependencies (pip/npm installs) still go under $HOME.
CI's result, when your task has one, already arrives in the task's envelope - read it there; do not re-run CI's suite just to confirm its verdict.
</environment_context>
